products.name: 3,000 kVA Inverter-Duty Padmount Transformer
products.short_description: Three-phase loop-feed padmount for solar and battery inverter step-up — 27.6 kV Delta primary to 600Y/347 V secondary.
products.description:
Built for inverter-duty service, this three-phase padmount steps a 27.6 kV Delta distribution feeder down to 600Y/347 V for solar, battery-storage and EV-charging sites.

The loop-feed high-voltage compartment keeps the circuit energized through the transformer, so a single unit can be isolated for service without dropping the rest of the loop. A high-grade magnetic core keeps sound levels and losses low, and heavy-duty active parts are braced for the harmonic and thermal cycling that inverter loads bring.

Every CANDRON transformer is factory-tested before it ships, and our team can adjust taps, accessories and termination details to suit your site.
highlights: Loop-feed high-voltage configuration for distribution continuity
High-grade magnetic core for lower sound and losses
Generously sized tank for easy field maintenance
